ChatBootstrapResponse.description: Ephemeral bootstrap greeting response. Conversation id is omitted until the first persisted user turn.

AssistantChatRequest.description: `message` is required unless `startConversation` is true; bootstrap requests cannot include `conversationId`.

Anonymous session continuity is maintained by an HttpOnly cookie set by the server.

The cookie name is workspace-specific (`anon_session_<workspaceId>`) and should be preserved by a browser or cookie jar rather than configured as a fixed client credential.
